# Justice Laws XML test fixtures (real Canadian federal law)

Unmodified files from https://github.com/justicecanada/laws-lois-xml at commit
`b7292cfb886d9e0ad60852e7eeb058ff07c5e71a` (Acts retrieved 2026-10-14, regulations and the repealed stubs 2026-10-18):

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `eng/acts/A-1.xml` | Access to Information Act, RSC 1985, c A-1, consolidated to 2026-06-14 (English) |
| `fra/lois/A-1.xml` | Loi sur l’accès à l’information, LRC 1985, c A-1, consolidated to 2026-06-14 (French) |
| `eng/acts/F-12.xml`, `fra/lois/F-12.xml` | Fish Inspection Act / Loi sur l’inspection du poisson: a wholly repealed Act whose consolidation holds only the repeal notice `[Repealed, 2012, c. 24, s. 76]` (nothing to ingest) |
| `eng/regulations/SOR-98-547.xml`, `fra/reglements/DORS-98-547.xml` | Leamy Lake Navigation Channel Regulations / Règlement sur le chenal de navigation du lac Leamy, SOR/98-547 (DORS/98-547), made under the National Capital Act, consolidated to 2007-05-31: making order, definitions (one repealed), a repealed section 3, Schedules 1 and 2 |
| `eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._1274.xml`, `fra/reglements/C.R.C.,_ch._1274.xml` | Armed Forces Postal Regulations / Règlement des postes pour les forces armées, C.R.C., c. 1274 (Consolidated Regulations of Canada, 1978), made under the Canada Post Corporation Act: repealed sections 4.1-4.3, a schedule table, repealed Schedules I and II |
| `eng/regulations/SI-2000-82.xml`, `fra/reglements/TR-2000-82.xml` | Reservation to the Crown Waiver Order (Tuktoyaktuk, N.W.T.) / Décret sur la renonciation aux terres réservées à la Couronne (Tuktoyaktuk, T.N.-O.), SI/2000-82 (TR/2000-82): an order in council with a schedule and no Body |
| `eng/regulations/SOR-78-148.xml`, `fra/reglements/DORS-78-148.xml` | Special Voting Rules / Règles électorales spéciales, SOR/78-148: a wholly repealed regulation holding only the repeal notice `[Repealed, 2018, c. 31, s. 398]` |
